```{r}
fer_swe_smooth <- fer$FRATNP$smooth$rate$FRATNP_ASFR

fer_swe_smooth[is.na(fer_swe_smooth)] = 0
```

```{r}
preprocess_fertility_change <- function(F) {
  # Input and output:
  #   rows    = ages
  #   columns = years

  F <- as.matrix(F)
  storage.mode(F) <- "double"

  if (ncol(F) < 2L) {
    stop("At least two years are required.")
  }

  # Do not interpolate genuine missing observations
  if (any(!is.finite(F))) {
    bad <- which(!is.finite(F), arr.ind = TRUE)

    print(data.frame(
      age = if (is.null(rownames(F))) {
        bad[, "row"]
      } else {
        rownames(F)[bad[, "row"]]
      },
      year = if (is.null(colnames(F))) {
        bad[, "col"]
      } else {
        colnames(F)[bad[, "col"]]
      },
      value = F[bad],
      row.names = NULL
    ))

    stop(
      "The input contains NA, NaN, or Inf values. ",
      "No interpolation was performed."
    )
  }

  previous <- F[, -ncol(F), drop = FALSE]
  current  <- F[, -1L,       drop = FALSE]

  numerator   <- 2 * (previous - current)
  denominator <- previous + current

  # Apply the paper's transformation where the denominator is positive
  change <- numerator / denominator

  # If both rates are zero, define the observed change as zero
  both_zero <- previous == 0 & current == 0
  change[both_zero] <- 0

  rownames(change) <- rownames(F)

  if (!is.null(colnames(F))) {
    colnames(change) <- colnames(F)[-1L]
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(change))) {
    stop("The transformation unexpectedly produced non-finite values.")
  }

  attr(change, "transformation") <-
    "2 * (previous - current) / (previous + current)"

  attr(change, "zero_zero_rule") <-
    "When previous = current = 0, annual change is defined as 0."

  change
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_10step_test_forecast <- function(
    result,
    X,
    window = "expanding",
    order_method = "adaptive_ic",
    h_plot = 10
) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  detail <- result$error_detail %>%
    filter(
      window_type == window,
      order_selection_method == order_method,
      method %in% c("farma", "far")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      available_horizons = map_int(error, ncol)
    )

  # Find test origins for which both methods produced all 10 horizons
  eligible_origins <- detail %>%
  dplyr::filter(available_horizons >= h_plot) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(t0, method) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(t0) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_methods = dplyr::n_distinct(method),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_methods == 2L)

  if (nrow(eligible_origins) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No test origin contains ",
      h_plot,
      " successful forecasts from both methods."
    )
  }

  # Latest origin with a complete 10-step forecast:
  # this displays the final 10 observed test curves
  selected_t0 <- max(eligible_origins$t0)

  selected <- detail %>%
    filter(t0 == selected_t0)

  proposed_row <- selected %>%
    filter(method == "farma") %>%
    slice(1)

  benchmark_row <- selected %>%
    filter(method == "far") %>%
    slice(1)

  if (nrow(proposed_row) != 1L || nrow(benchmark_row) != 1L) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify both forecasting methods.")
  }

  target_indices <- selected_t0 + seq_len(h_plot)

  observed <- X[
    ,
    target_indices,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  proposed_error <- proposed_row$error[[1]][
    ,
    seq_len(h_plot),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  benchmark_error <- benchmark_row$error[[1]][
    ,
    seq_len(h_plot),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # The pipeline defines testing error as forecast - observed
  proposed_forecast <- observed + proposed_error
  benchmark_forecast <- observed + benchmark_error

  p_hat <- proposed_row$p_est[[1]]
  q_hat <- proposed_row$q_est[[1]]
  d_hat <- proposed_row$d_used[[1]]

  proposed_label <- sprintf(
    "Proposed FARFIMA(%d, %.2f, %d)",
    p_hat,
    d_hat,
    q_hat
  )

  benchmark_label <- "Benchmark FARFIMA(1, 1, 0)"

  target_years <- if (!is.null(colnames(X))) {
    colnames(X)[target_indices]
  } else {
    as.character(target_indices)
  }

  origin_year <- if (!is.null(colnames(X))) {
    colnames(X)[selected_t0]
  } else {
    as.character(selected_t0)
  }

  age_labels <- if (!is.null(rownames(X))) {
    rownames(X)
  } else {
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(X)))
  }

  matrix_to_long <- function(M, series_name) {
    data.frame(
      age_index = rep(
        seq_len(nrow(M)),
        times = ncol(M)
      ),
      horizon = rep(
        seq_len(ncol(M)),
        each = nrow(M)
      ),
      value = as.vector(M),
      series = series_name
    )
  }

  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    matrix_to_long(observed, "Observed"),
    matrix_to_long(proposed_forecast, proposed_label),
    matrix_to_long(benchmark_forecast, benchmark_label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_year = target_years[horizon],
      panel = paste0(
        "h = ",
        horizon,
        "  |  ",
        target_year
      ),
      series = factor(
        series,
        levels = c(
          "Observed",
          proposed_label,
          benchmark_label
        )
      )
    )

  colours <- setNames(
    c(
      "black",
      "#D62728",
      "#2F5597"
    ),
    c(
      "Observed",
      proposed_label,
      benchmark_label
    )
  )

  line_types <- setNames(
    c(
      "solid",
      "solid",
      "dashed"
    ),
    c(
      "Observed",
      proposed_label,
      benchmark_label
    )
  )

  age_breaks <- unique(round(
    seq(
      1,
      nrow(X),
      length.out = 6
    )
  ))

  forecast_plot <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = age_index,
      y = value,
      colour = series,
      linetype = series
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~panel,
      ncol = 5,
      scales = "fixed"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colours) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = line_types) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = age_breaks,
      labels = age_labels[age_breaks]
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Ten-step forecasts for Slovakian fertility changes",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Latest complete test origin: ",
        origin_year
      ),
      x = "Age",
      y = "Annual fertility-rate change",
      colour = NULL,
      linetype = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = "grey60"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")
    )

  list(
    plot = forecast_plot,
    data = plot_data,
    origin_index = selected_t0,
    origin_year = origin_year,
    target_years = target_years,
    proposed_forecast = proposed_forecast,
    benchmark_forecast = benchmark_forecast,
    observed = observed
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(demography)

Swe_mortality <- read.demogdata(
  file = "Mx_1x1_sweden.txt",
  popfile = "Exposures_1x1.txt",
  type = "mortality",

)

x_mat_male = Swe_mortality$rate$male 
x_mat_female = Swe_mortality$rate$female 

# Remove NA with 0
x_mat_male[is.na(x_mat_male)] <- 10^-4
x_mat_female[is.na(x_mat_female)] <- 10^-4
x_mat_male[x_mat_male <= 0] <- 10^-4
x_mat_female[x_mat_female <= 0] <- 10^-4

# log
x_mat_male = x_mat_male %>% log()
x_mat_female = x_mat_female %>% log()

```

```{r}
require(demography)
require(ftsa)
require(imputeTS)
require(ggplot2)
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)
require(stringr)
require(vars)
require(doMC)

AU_demo = extract.ages(read.demogdata(file = "Mx_1x1_au.txt", popfile = "Exposures_1x1_AU.txt", type = "mortality", label = "AU"), 0:100)

# set those rates > 1 to 1

AU_demo$rate$female = replace(AU_demo$rate$female, which(AU_demo$rate$female > 1), NA)
AU_demo$rate$male   = replace(AU_demo$rate$male,   which(AU_demo$rate$male > 1),   NA)

####################
## smooth demogdata
####################

# AU_demo_smooth <- smooth.demogdata(AU_demo)

# set those 0 values to NA

AU_demo$rate$female = replace(AU_demo$rate$female, which(AU_demo$rate$female == 0), NA)
AU_demo$rate$male   = replace(AU_demo$rate$male,   which(AU_demo$rate$male == 0), NA)

# na.interp those NAs

n_age = nrow(AU_demo$rate$female)  # 96
n_year = ncol(AU_demo$rate$female) # 272

# linear interpolation for each age over years

AU_demo_rate_female = AU_demo_rate_male = matrix(NA, n_age, n_year)
for(ik in 1:n_age)
{
    AU_demo_rate_female[ik,] = na_interpolation(AU_demo$rate$female[ik,])
    AU_demo_rate_male[ik,]   = na_interpolation(AU_demo$rate$male[ik,])
    rm(ik)
}

AU_demo_female_log = log(AU_demo_rate_female, base = 10)
AU_demo_male_log   = log(AU_demo_rate_male, base = 10)
colnames(AU_demo_female_log) = colnames(AU_demo_male_log) = AU_demo$year
rownames(AU_demo_female_log) = rownames(AU_demo_male_log) = AU_demo$age
```

```{r}
extract_real_data_metrics <- function(real_result)
{
  error_detail <-
    real_result$error_detail

  conformal_summary_detail <-
    real_result$conformal_summary_detail

  if (nrow(error_detail) == 0)
  {
    stop("error_detail is empty.")
  }

  if (nrow(conformal_summary_detail) == 0)
  {
    stop("conformal_summary_detail is empty.")
  }

  if (!"d_used" %in% names(error_detail))
  {
    error_detail$d_used <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!"d_used" %in% names(conformal_summary_detail))
  {
    conformal_summary_detail$d_used <- NA_real_
  }

  point_summary_long <- error_detail %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      horizon_stats =
        purrr::map(
          error,
          function(error_mat)
          {
            tibble::tibble(
              h =
                seq_len(
                  ncol(error_mat)
                ),

              SSE =
                apply(
                  error_mat,
                  2,
                  function(x)
                  {
                    x <- x[
                      is.finite(x)
                    ]

                    sum(
                      x^2
                    )
                  }
                ),

              SAE =
                apply(
                  error_mat,
                  2,
                  function(x)
                  {
                    x <- x[
                      is.finite(x)
                    ]

                    sum(
                      abs(x)
                    )
                  }
                ),

              n_forecast =
                apply(
                  error_mat,
                  2,
                  function(x)
                  {
                    sum(
                      is.finite(x)
                    )
                  }
                )
            )
          }
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      window_type,
      method,
      d_used,
      horizon_stats
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(
      horizon_stats
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      window_type,
      method,
      d_used,
      h
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      SSE =
        sum(
          SSE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      SAE =
        sum(
          SAE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      n_forecast =
        sum(
          n_forecast,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      RMSE =
        sqrt(
          SSE /
            n_forecast
        ),

      MAE =
        SAE /
          n_forecast,

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      window_type,
      method,
      h
    )

  ratio_summary <- point_summary_long %>%
    dplyr::select(
      window_type,
      method,
      h,
      d_used,
      RMSE,
      MAE
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from =
        method,

      values_from =
        c(
          d_used,
          RMSE,
          MAE
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      RMSE_ratio =
        RMSE_farma /
          RMSE_far,

      MAE_ratio =
        MAE_farma /
          MAE_far
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      window_type,
      h
    )

  interval_summary <- conformal_summary_detail %>%
    dplyr::select(
      window_type,
      method,
      d_used,
      alpha,
      h,
      ECP,
      CPD,
      Score
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      window_type,
      method,
      alpha,
      h
    )

  list(
    point_summary_long =
      point_summary_long,

    ratio_summary =
      ratio_summary,

    interval_summary =
      interval_summary
  )
}
```





```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

process_boe_glc_sheet <- function(
    file,
    sheet = "1. fwds, short end",
    min_points_per_day = 10,
    min_date_coverage = 0.80,
    target_grid = NULL,
    remove_missing_days = TRUE
) {

  raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    file,
    sheet = sheet,
    col_names = FALSE
  )

  raw <- as.data.frame(raw)

  years_row <- which(
    apply(
      raw,
      1,
      function(x) {
        any(
          grepl(
            "years",
            as.character(x),
            ignore.case = TRUE
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )[1]

  if (is.na(years_row)) {
    stop("Cannot find the maturity-years row.")
  }

  maturity <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      unlist(
        raw[years_row, -1]
      )
    )
  )

  date_raw <- raw[[1]]

  date_1 <- suppressWarnings(
    as.Date(
      date_raw,
      format = "%d %b %y"
    )
  )

  date_2 <- suppressWarnings(
    as.Date(
      as.numeric(date_raw),
      origin = "1899-12-30"
    )
  )

  dates <- date_1

  dates[is.na(dates)] <- date_2[is.na(dates)]

  data_start <- which(!is.na(dates))[1]

  if (is.na(data_start)) {
    stop("Cannot find the first data row.")
  }

  dates <- dates[data_start:nrow(raw)]

  value_raw <- raw[
    data_start:nrow(raw),
    -1,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  value_mat <- apply(
    value_raw,
    2,
    function(x) {
      x <- as.character(x)

      x <- stringr::str_trim(x)

      x[x %in% c("", "na", "NA", "Na", "n/a", "N/A")] <- NA

      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(x)
      )
    }
  )

  value_mat <- as.matrix(value_mat)

  keep_col <- is.finite(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  keep_row <- !is.na(dates)

  dates <- dates[keep_row]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    keep_row,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  coverage_by_maturity <- colMeans(
    is.finite(value_mat)
  )

  keep_col <- coverage_by_maturity >= min_date_coverage

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  ord <- order(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[ord]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    ord,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (is.null(target_grid)) {
    target_grid <- maturity
  }

  interp_mat <- t(
    apply(
      value_mat,
      1,
      function(y) {

        ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(maturity)

        if (sum(ok) < min_points_per_day) {
          return(
            rep(
              NA_real_,
              length(target_grid)
            )
          )
        }

        approx(
          x = maturity[ok],
          y = y[ok],
          xout = target_grid,
          rule = 1
        )$y
      }
    )
  )

  if (remove_missing_days) {

    keep_day <- apply(
      interp_mat,
      1,
      function(x) {
        all(is.finite(x))
      }
    )

    interp_mat <- interp_mat[
      keep_day,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    dates <- dates[keep_day]
  }

  X <- t(interp_mat)

  rownames(X) <- target_grid

  colnames(X) <- as.character(dates)

  list(
    X = X,
    dates = dates,
    maturity = target_grid,
    sheet = sheet,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      sheet = sheet,
      start_date = min(dates),
      end_date = max(dates),
      n_days = length(dates),
      n_maturities = nrow(X),
      min_maturity = min(target_grid),
      max_maturity = max(target_grid)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

process_rba_f17_sheet <- function(
    file,
    sheet = "Yields",
    drop_zero_maturity = TRUE,
    min_date_coverage = 0.80,
    target_grid = NULL,
    remove_missing_days = TRUE
) {

  raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    file,
    sheet = sheet,
    col_names = FALSE
  )

  raw <- as.data.frame(raw)

  series_row <- which(
    as.character(raw[[1]]) == "Series ID"
  )[1]

  if (is.na(series_row)) {
    stop("Cannot find Series ID row.")
  }

  title_row <- which(
    as.character(raw[[1]]) == "Title"
  )[1]

  if (is.na(title_row)) {
    stop("Cannot find Title row.")
  }

  maturity_text <- as.character(
    unlist(
      raw[title_row, -1]
    )
  )

  maturity <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      stringr::str_match(
        maturity_text,
        "([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*)\\s*yrs"
      )[, 2]
    )
  )

  data_start <- series_row + 1

  date_raw <- raw[[1]][data_start:nrow(raw)]

  date_num <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(date_raw)
  )

  dates <- as.Date(
    date_num,
    origin = "1899-12-30"
  )

  value_raw <- raw[
    data_start:nrow(raw),
    -1,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  value_mat <- apply(
    value_raw,
    2,
    function(x) {
      x <- as.character(x)
      x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
      x[x %in% c("", "na", "NA", "Na", "n/a", "N/A")] <- NA
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }
  )

  value_mat <- as.matrix(value_mat)

  keep_col <- is.finite(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (drop_zero_maturity) {

    keep_col <- maturity > 0

    maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

    value_mat <- value_mat[
      ,
      keep_col,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  keep_row <- !is.na(dates)

  dates <- dates[keep_row]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    keep_row,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  coverage_by_maturity <- colMeans(
    is.finite(value_mat)
  )

  keep_col <- coverage_by_maturity >= min_date_coverage

  maturity <- maturity[keep_col]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    keep_col,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  ord <- order(maturity)

  maturity <- maturity[ord]

  value_mat <- value_mat[
    ,
    ord,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!is.null(target_grid)) {

    interp_mat <- t(
      apply(
        value_mat,
        1,
        function(y) {

          ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(maturity)

          if (sum(ok) < 5) {
            return(
              rep(
                NA_real_,
                length(target_grid)
              )
            )
          }

          approx(
            x = maturity[ok],
            y = y[ok],
            xout = target_grid,
            rule = 1
          )$y
        }
      )
    )

    maturity <- target_grid
    value_mat <- interp_mat
  }

  if (remove_missing_days) {

    keep_day <- apply(
      value_mat,
      1,
      function(x) {
        all(is.finite(x))
      }
    )

    value_mat <- value_mat[
      keep_day,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    dates <- dates[keep_day]
  }

  X <- t(value_mat)

  rownames(X) <- maturity

  colnames(X) <- as.character(dates)

  list(
    X = X,
    dates = dates,
    maturity = maturity,
    sheet = sheet,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      sheet = sheet,
      start_date = min(dates),
      end_date = max(dates),
      n_days = length(dates),
      n_maturities = nrow(X),
      min_maturity = min(maturity),
      max_maturity = max(maturity)
    )
  )
}

subset_rba_by_date <- function(
    dat,
    start_date = NULL,
    end_date = NULL
) {

  dates <- dat$dates

  keep <- rep(TRUE, length(dates))

  if (!is.null(start_date)) {
    keep <- keep & dates >= as.Date(start_date)
  }

  if (!is.null(end_date)) {
    keep <- keep & dates <= as.Date(end_date)
  }

  X_sub <- dat$X[
    ,
    keep,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  dates_sub <- dates[keep]

  list(
    X = X_sub,
    dates = dates_sub,
    maturity = dat$maturity,
    sheet = dat$sheet,
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      sheet = dat$sheet,
      start_date = min(dates_sub),
      end_date = max(dates_sub),
      n_days = length(dates_sub),
      n_maturities = nrow(X_sub),
      min_maturity = min(dat$maturity),
      max_maturity = max(dat$maturity)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

spy_raw <- data.table::fread(
  "1_min_SPY_2008-2021.csv"
)

spy_dat <- spy_raw %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(tolower)

spy_dat <- spy_dat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    datetime_chr = gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(date)),
    datetime = as.POSIXct(
      datetime_chr,
      format = "%Y%m%d %H:%M:%S"
    ),
    trading_date = as.Date(datetime),
    time = format(datetime, "%H:%M:%S")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(datetime),
    is.finite(close),
    close > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    trading_date,
    datetime
  )

spy_minute <- spy_dat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    trading_date,
    datetime,
    time
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    close = dplyr::last(close),
    volume = sum(volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    time >= "07:30:00",
    time <= "13:59:00"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    trading_date,
    datetime
  )

spy_minute <- spy_minute %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trading_date) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_minute_day = dplyr::n()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_minute_day >= 390
  )

spy_minute <- spy_minute %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trading_date) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:390) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    minute_index = dplyr::row_number(),
    log_price = log(close),
    log_return = log_price - dplyr::lag(log_price)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(log_return)
  )

spy_dat_5 <- spy_minute %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bin_5min = floor((minute_index - 1) / 5) + 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    bin_5min >= 1,
    bin_5min <= 78
  )

spy_vol_tbl_5 <- spy_dat_5 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    trading_date,
    bin_5min
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    rv = sum(log_return^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log_rv = log(rv + 1e-10)
  )

complete_days_5 <- spy_vol_tbl_5 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trading_date) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bins = dplyr::n_distinct(bin_5min),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_bins == 78
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(trading_date)

spy_vol_tbl_5 <- spy_vol_tbl_5 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    trading_date %in% complete_days_5
  )

spy_vol_wide_5 <- spy_vol_tbl_5 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    bin_5min,
    trading_date,
    log_rv
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = trading_date,
    values_from = log_rv
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(bin_5min)

X_spy_vol_5 <- as.matrix(
  spy_vol_wide_5[, -1, drop = FALSE]
)

rownames(X_spy_vol_5) <- paste0(
  "bin_",
  spy_vol_wide_5$bin_5min
)

spy_dates_5 <- as.Date(
  colnames(X_spy_vol_5)
)

keep_col_5 <- apply(
  X_spy_vol_5,
  2,
  function(x) all(is.finite(x))
)

X_spy_vol_5 <- X_spy_vol_5[
  ,
  keep_col_5,
  drop = FALSE
]

spy_dates_5 <- spy_dates_5[keep_col_5]

grid_5 <- 1:nrow(X_spy_vol_5)

X_spy_vol_5_smooth <- apply(
  X_spy_vol_5,
  2,
  function(y) {
    predict(
      smooth.spline(
        x = grid_5,
        y = y,
        spar = 0.5
      ),
      x = grid_5
    )$y
  }
)

X_spy_vol_5_smooth <- as.matrix(X_spy_vol_5_smooth)

rownames(X_spy_vol_5_smooth) <- rownames(X_spy_vol_5)
colnames(X_spy_vol_5_smooth) <- colnames(X_spy_vol_5)

dim(X_spy_vol_5)
dim(X_spy_vol_5_smooth)
range(spy_dates_5)



plot(
  fts(1:nrow(X_spy_vol_5_smooth), X_spy_vol_5_smooth),
  xlab = "Age",
  ylab = "Male log mortality rate"
)
```

```{r}
screen_order_selection_no_d <- function(X,
                                        train_ratio = 0.6,
                                        p_max = 5,
                                        q_max = 5,
                                        Npc = 1)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (any(!is.finite(X))) {
    stop("X contains NA, NaN or Inf values.")
  }

  T <- ncol(X)

  train_end <- floor(T * train_ratio)

  X_initial_train <- X[, 1:train_end, drop = FALSE]

  order_out <- select_order_far_full(
    X = X_initial_train,
    p_max = p_max,
    q_max = q_max,
    Npc = Npc
  )

  p_est <- as.integer(order_out$p_hat)

  q_est <- as.integer(order_out$q_hat)

  list(
    model_summary =
      tibble::tibble(
        T = T,
        train_end = train_end,
        d_hat = 0,
        p_est = p_est,
        q_est = q_est,
        total_order = p_est + q_est,
        Npc = Npc
      ),
    order_selection_detail = order_out
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

Swe_fertility <- read.table(
  "SWEasfrTR.txt",
  skip = 2,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

Swe_fertility <- Swe_fertility %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Age_raw = Age,
    Age_num = dplyr::case_when(
      Age == "12-" ~ 12,
      Age == "55+" ~ 55,
      TRUE ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Age))
    ),
    ASFR = as.numeric(ASFR)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Year),
    is.finite(Age_num),
    is.finite(ASFR)
  )

Swe_fertility <- Swe_fertility %>%
  group_by(Year, Age_num) %>%
  summarise(
    ASFR = mean(ASFR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Swe_fertility_wide <- Swe_fertility %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = ASFR
  ) %>%
  arrange(Age_num)

x_mat_fert <- as.matrix(
  Swe_fertility_wide[, -1, drop = FALSE]
)

rownames(x_mat_fert) <- Swe_fertility_wide$Age_num
```

```{r}
library(fds)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

data(ECBYieldcurve)
data(Yieldcurve)
data(FedYieldcurve)

extract_fds_matrix <- function(obj) {
  
  if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    X <- obj
  } else if (!is.null(obj$y)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$y)
  } else if (!is.null(obj$data)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$data)
  } else {
    stop("Cannot extract matrix.")
  }
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  
  X
}

prepare_yield_X <- function(X) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    function(x) all(is.finite(x))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(x) all(is.finite(x))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}

screen_one_yield <- function(dataset_name,
                             fracdiff_trim = 20,
                             B = 199,
                             seed = 111) {
  
  obj <- get(dataset_name)
  
  X <- extract_fds_matrix(obj)
  X <- prepare_yield_X(X)
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    screen_order_selection_compact(
      X = X,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = B,
      fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim,
      seed = seed
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "error")) {
    return(
      tibble(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        n_grid = nrow(X),
        T = ncol(X),
        d_hat = NA_real_,
        p_est = NA_integer_,
        q_est = NA_integer_,
        total_order = NA_integer_,
        error_message = out$message
      )
    )
  }
  
  out$model_summary %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      n_grid = nrow(X),
      total_order = p_est + q_est,
      error_message = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      n_grid,
      T,
      train_end,
      d_hat,
      p_est,
      q_est,
      total_order,
      fracdiff_trim,
      error_message
    )
}

yield_names <- c(
  "ECBYieldcurve",
  "Yieldcurve",
  "FedYieldcurve"
)

yield_screen <- map_dfr(
  yield_names,
  screen_one_yield,
  fracdiff_trim = 100,
  B = 199,
  seed = 1
)

yield_screen %>%
  arrange(desc(total_order), dataset)
```

```{r}
screen_temp_windows <- function(X,
                                dataset_name,
                                window_size = 365,
                                step_size = 90,
                                fracdiff_trim = 50,
                                B = 199,
                                seed = 111) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  T <- ncol(X)
  
  start_vec <- seq(
    1,
    T - window_size + 1,
    by = step_size
  )
  
  purrr::map_dfr(
    start_vec,
    function(s) {
      
      e <- s + window_size - 1
      
      X_sub <- X[, s:e, drop = FALSE]
      
      out <- tryCatch(
        screen_order_selection_compact(
          X = X_sub,
          train_ratio = 0.6,
          p_max = 5,
          q_max = 5,
          Npc = 1,
          B = B,
          fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim,
          seed = seed
        ),
        error = function(err) err
      )
      
      if (inherits(out, "error")) {
        return(
          tibble::tibble(
            dataset = dataset_name,
            window_size = window_size,
            start_col = s,
            end_col = e,
            T = ncol(X_sub),
            d_hat = NA_real_,
            p_est = NA_integer_,
            q_est = NA_integer_,
            total_order = NA_integer_,
            error_message = out$message
          )
        )
      }
      
      out$model_summary %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          dataset = dataset_name,
          window_size = window_size,
          start_col = s,
          end_col = e,
          total_order = p_est + q_est,
          error_message = NA_character_
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          dataset,
          window_size,
          start_col,
          end_col,
          T,
          d_hat,
          p_est,
          q_est,
          total_order,
          error_message,
          dplyr::everything()
        )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(fds)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

data(SAelectdemand)

extract_fds_matrix <- function(obj) {
  
  if (!is.null(obj$y)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$y)
  } else if (!is.null(obj$data)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$data)
  } else if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    X <- obj
  } else {
    stop("Cannot extract matrix.")
  }
  
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  X
}

prepare_positive_X <- function(X, small_value = 10^-6) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  X[is.na(X)] <- small_value
  X[X <= 0] <- small_value
  
  X <- log(X)
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}

center_by_group_train <- function(X, groups, train_ratio = 0.6) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  groups <- as.character(groups)
  
  if (length(groups) != ncol(X)) {
    stop("length(groups) must equal ncol(X).")
  }
  
  train_end <- floor(ncol(X) * train_ratio)
  train_idx <- 1:train_end
  
  X_centered <- X
  
  global_mean <- rowMeans(
    X[, train_idx, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  group_mean_list <- list()
  
  for (g in unique(groups)) {
    
    idx_train_g <- train_idx[groups[train_idx] == g]
    
    if (length(idx_train_g) == 0) {
      mean_g <- global_mean
    } else {
      mean_g <- rowMeans(
        X[, idx_train_g, drop = FALSE],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
    
    idx_all_g <- which(groups == g)
    
    X_centered[, idx_all_g] <- sweep(
      X[, idx_all_g, drop = FALSE],
      1,
      mean_g,
      "-"
    )
    
    group_mean_list[[g]] <- mean_g
  }
  
  list(
    X = X_centered,
    groups = groups,
    group_mean_list = group_mean_list,
    train_end = train_end
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

make_scores_for_far_order <- function(X,
                                      K = NULL,
                                      pve = 0.95,
                                      center = TRUE)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (center) {
    mean_curve <- rowMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE)
    Xc <- sweep(X, 1, mean_curve, "-")
  } else {
    mean_curve <- rep(0, nrow(X))
    Xc <- X
  }

  cov_op <- cov(t(Xc))

  eig <- eigen(cov_op, symmetric = TRUE)

  eig_values <- eig$values
  eig_vectors <- eig$vectors

  eig_values[eig_values < 0] <- 0

  if (is.null(K)) {
    pve_vec <- cumsum(eig_values) / sum(eig_values)
    K <- which(pve_vec >= pve)[1]
  }

  phi <- eig_vectors[, 1:K, drop = FALSE]

  scores <- t(phi) %*% Xc

  list(
    scores = t(scores),
    phi = phi,
    mean_curve = mean_curve,
    K = K,
    pve = sum(eig_values[1:K]) / sum(eig_values)
  )
}

fit_score_var_resid <- function(scores, p)
{
  scores <- as.matrix(scores)

  T <- nrow(scores)
  K <- ncol(scores)

  if (p == 0) {
    Y <- scores
    Xreg <- matrix(1, nrow = T, ncol = 1)
  } else {
    idx <- (p + 1):T

    Y <- scores[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    Xreg <- matrix(1, nrow = length(idx), ncol = 1)

    for (j in 1:p) {
      Xreg <- cbind(
        Xreg,
        scores[idx - j, , drop = FALSE]
      )
    }
  }

  coef_hat <- solve(
    crossprod(Xreg),
    crossprod(Xreg, Y)
  )

  resid <- Y - Xreg %*% coef_hat

  Sigma <- crossprod(resid) / nrow(resid)

  list(
    resid = resid,
    Sigma = Sigma,
    n = nrow(resid),
    K = K,
    p = p
  )
}

safe_logdet <- function(Sigma, ridge = 1e-8)
{
  Sigma <- as.matrix(Sigma)

  K <- nrow(Sigma)

  Sigma <- Sigma + diag(ridge, K)

  as.numeric(determinant(Sigma, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus)
}

kr_test_one_lag <- function(scores, p_restricted, ridge = 1e-8)
{
  scores <- as.matrix(scores)

  p_full <- p_restricted + 1

  T <- nrow(scores)
  K <- ncol(scores)

  idx <- (p_full + 1):T

  Y <- scores[idx, , drop = FALSE]

  X_restricted <- matrix(1, nrow = length(idx), ncol = 1)

  if (p_restricted > 0) {
    for (j in 1:p_restricted) {
      X_restricted <- cbind(
        X_restricted,
        scores[idx - j, , drop = FALSE]
      )
    }
  }

  X_full <- X_restricted

  X_full <- cbind(
    X_full,
    scores[idx - p_full, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  coef_restricted <- solve(
    crossprod(X_restricted),
    crossprod(X_restricted, Y)
  )

  coef_full <- solve(
    crossprod(X_full),
    crossprod(X_full, Y)
  )

  resid_restricted <- Y - X_restricted %*% coef_restricted
  resid_full <- Y - X_full %*% coef_full

  Sigma_restricted <- crossprod(resid_restricted) / nrow(resid_restricted)
  Sigma_full <- crossprod(resid_full) / nrow(resid_full)

  stat <- nrow(Y) * (
    safe_logdet(Sigma_restricted, ridge = ridge) -
      safe_logdet(Sigma_full, ridge = ridge)
  )

  df <- K * K

  p_value <- pchisq(
    stat,
    df = df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    test = paste0("FAR(", p_restricted, ") vs FAR(", p_full, ")"),
    p_restricted = p_restricted,
    p_full = p_full,
    K = K,
    n_eff = nrow(Y),
    statistic = stat,
    df = df,
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

select_order_far_KR_style <- function(X,
                                      p_max = 5,
                                      K = NULL,
                                      pve = 0.95,
                                      alpha = 0.05,
                                      center = TRUE,
                                      ridge = 1e-8)
{
  score_out <- make_scores_for_far_order(
    X = X,
    K = K,
    pve = pve,
    center = center
  )

  scores <- score_out$scores

  test_table <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      0:(p_max - 1),
      function(p0) {
        kr_test_one_lag(
          scores = scores,
          p_restricted = p0,
          ridge = ridge
        )
      }
    )
  )

  reject_vec <- test_table$p_value < alpha

  if (!reject_vec[1]) {
    p_hat <- 0
  } else {
    first_non_reject <- which(!reject_vec)

    if (length(first_non_reject) == 0) {
      p_hat <- p_max
    } else {
      p_hat <- test_table$p_restricted[first_non_reject[1]]
    }
  }

  list(
    p_hat = p_hat,
    test_table = test_table,
    K = score_out$K,
    pve_used = score_out$pve,
    score_detail = score_out
  )
}
```



```{r}
run_KR_check_after_fracdiff <- function(X,
                                        d_hat,
                                        p_max = 5,
                                        K = NULL,
                                        pve = 0.95,
                                        alpha = 0.05,
                                        fracdiff_trim = 100,
                                        center = TRUE)
{
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (d_hat == 0) {
    X_diff <- X
  } else {
    X_diff <- FracDiff(
      x = t(X),
      d = d_hat
    ) %>%
      t()
  }

  if (d_hat == 0) {
    X_diff_use <- X_diff
  } else {
    X_diff_use <- X_diff[, (fracdiff_trim + 1):ncol(X_diff), drop = FALSE]
  }

  out <- select_order_far_KR_style(
    X = X_diff_use,
    p_max = p_max,
    K = K,
    pve = pve,
    alpha = alpha,
    center = center
  )

  list(
    d_hat = d_hat,
    p_hat_KR = out$p_hat,
    K = out$K,
    pve_used = out$pve_used,
    test_table = out$test_table,
    X_diff_use = X_diff_use
  )
}
```

```{r}
make_CIDR_curves <- function(X_price,
                             step = 5,
                             scale = 100) {
  
  X_price <- as.matrix(X_price)
  storage.mode(X_price) <- "numeric"
  
  X_price[X_price <= 0] <- NA_real_
  
  idx_5min <- seq(1, nrow(X_price), by = step)
  
  X_5min_price <- X_price[idx_5min, , drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X_5min_price,
    2,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X_5min_price <- X_5min_price[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  log_price <- log(X_5min_price)
  
  X_CIDR <- scale * sweep(
    log_price,
    MARGIN = 2,
    STATS = log_price[1, ],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  X_CIDR <- X_CIDR[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  
  rownames(X_CIDR) <- paste0("u", seq_len(nrow(X_CIDR)))
  
  X_CIDR
}
```

```{r}
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}
```

```{r}
library(fds)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

data(SAelectdemand)

extract_fds_matrix <- function(obj) {
  
  if (!is.null(obj$y)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$y)
  } else if (!is.null(obj$data)) {
    X <- as.matrix(obj$data)
  } else if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    X <- obj
  } else {
    stop("Cannot extract matrix.")
  }
  
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  X
}

prepare_positive_X <- function(X, small_value = 10^-6) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  X[is.na(X)] <- small_value
  X[X <= 0] <- small_value
  
  X <- log(X)
  
  keep_col <- apply(
    X,
    2,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep_row <- apply(
    X,
    1,
    function(z) all(is.finite(z))
  )
  
  X <- X[keep_row, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X
}

center_by_weekday_whole <- function(X, dates) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  weekday <- weekdays(dates)
  
  X_centered <- X
  
  for (g in unique(weekday)) {
    
    idx <- which(weekday == g)
    
    mean_g <- rowMeans(
      X[, idx, drop = FALSE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    X_centered[, idx] <- sweep(
      X[, idx, drop = FALSE],
      MARGIN = 1,
      STATS = mean_g,
      FUN = "-"
    )
  }
  
  X_centered
}

difference_weekly <- function(X, lag = 7) {
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  X_diff <- X[, (lag + 1):ncol(X), drop = FALSE] -
    X[, 1:(ncol(X) - lag), drop = FALSE]
  
  X_diff
}

screen_one_version <- function(X,
                               dataset,
                               fracdiff_trim = 100,
                               seed = 111) {
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    screen_order_selection_compact(
      X = X,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 199,
      fracdiff_trim = fracdiff_trim,
      seed = seed
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "error")) {
    return(
      tibble(
        dataset = dataset,
        T = ncol(X),
        d_hat = NA_real_,
        p_est = NA_integer_,
        q_est = NA_integer_,
        total_order = NA_integer_,
        error_message = out$message
      )
    )
  }
  
  out$model_summary %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset,
      total_order = p_est + q_est,
      error_message = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      T,
      train_end,
      d_hat,
      p_est,
      q_est,
      total_order,
      fracdiff_trim,
      error_message,
      everything()
    )
}
```

```{r}
compare_one_origin_rmse <- function(
    result,
    X,
    step_show = 40,
    window_show = "expanding",
    methods_show = c("farma", "far")
) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  result$error_detail %>%
    filter(
      window_type == window_show,
      step == step_show,
      method %in% methods_show
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rmse_by_h = map(error, function(e_mat) {
        tibble(
          h = seq_len(ncol(e_mat)),
          RMSE = apply(e_mat, 2, function(z) sqrt(mean(z^2, na.rm = TRUE))),
          MAE = apply(e_mat, 2, function(z) mean(abs(z), na.rm = TRUE))
        )
      })
    ) %>%
    select(method, window_type, step, t0, rmse_by_h) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(rmse_by_h)
}
```

```{r}
library(arfima)

one_run <- function(T = 200, d_true = 0.3, phi = 0.9, p_max = 5) {
  
  x <- arfima::arfima.sim(
    n = T,
    model = list(
      phi = phi,
      dfrac = d_true,
      theta = numeric(0)
    )
  )
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  
  d_direct <- local_whittle(x)
  
  ar_fit <- ar(x, aic = TRUE, order.max = p_max, demean = TRUE)
  e <- ar_fit$resid
  e <- e[!is.na(e)]
  
  d_filtered <- local_whittle(e)
  
  c(
    d_true = d_true,
    phi = phi,
    d_direct = d_direct,
    d_filtered = d_filtered,
    ar_order = ar_fit$order
  )
}

sim_study <- function(R = 100,
                      T_vals = c(200, 500, 1000),
                      d_vals = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5),
                      phi_vals = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9),
                      p_max = 5) {
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (T in T_vals) {
    for (d in d_vals) {
      for (phi in phi_vals) {
        
        res <- replicate(
          R,
          one_run(T = T, d_true = d, phi = phi, p_max = p_max),
          simplify = TRUE
        )
        
        res <- as.data.frame(t(res))
        res$T <- T
        out[[k]] <- res
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

set.seed(123)
sim_res <- sim_study(R = 100)

summary_res <- aggregate(
  cbind(d_direct, d_filtered) ~ T + d_true + phi,
  data = sim_res,
  FUN = mean
)

summary_res$bias_direct <- summary_res$d_direct - summary_res$d_true
summary_res$bias_filtered <- summary_res$d_filtered - summary_res$d_true

summary_res
```

```{r}
########################################################
# Geometrically decaying weighted (long-run covariance)
# The procedure of Isreal Martinez
########################################################

# eigenvalue ratio criterion

select_K <- function(tau, eigenvalue)
{
    k_max = length(eigenvalue)
    k_all = rep(0, k_max-1)
    for(k in 1:(k_max-1))
    {
      k_all[k] = (eigenvalue[k+1]/eigenvalue[k])*ifelse(eigenvalue[k]/eigenvalue[1] > tau, 1, 0) + ifelse(eigenvalue[k]/eigenvalue[1] < tau, 1, 0)
    }
    K_hat = which.min(k_all)
    return(K_hat)
}


GW_LRC_nonstationary <- function(beta, dat, fh, fmethod = c("ets", "arima"))
{
    fmethod = match.arg(fmethod)
    n = ncol(dat)
    n_dim = nrow(dat)
    
    # equal weight or geometrically decaying weight
    
    if(is.null(beta))
    {
        q = rep(1/n, n)
    }
    else
    {
        q = beta * (1 - beta)^(0:(n - 1))
    }
    
    # compute mean
    
    # my = apply(dat, 1, weighted.mean, w = rev(q))
    my = rowMeans(dat)
    
    # de-center data by subtracting the mean term
    
    new_dat = sweep(x = t(dat), MARGIN = 2, STATS = my, FUN = "-")
    
    # first-order differencing of de-centered data
    
    new_dat_diff = matrix(NA, (n-1), nrow(dat))
    for(ik in 1:(n-1))
    {
        new_dat_diff[ik,] = new_dat[(ik+1),] - new_dat[ik,]
    }
    
    # equal weighted or geometrically decaying weighted de-centered data
    
    wq = diag(rev(q)[-n])
    new_dat2 = wq %*% new_dat_diff * (n-1)
    
    # compute long-run covariance for differenced data
    
    LRC_est = long_run_covariance_estimation(dat = t(new_dat2))
    eigen_decomp = eigen(LRC_est, symmetric = TRUE)
    
    # determine ncomp by the ratio method
    
    lambda_val = eigen_decomp$values[which(eigen_decomp$values > 0)]
    ncomp = select_K(tau = 1/log(max(lambda_val[1], length(lambda_val))), eigenvalue = lambda_val)
    rm(lambda_val); rm(LRC_est)
    
    # compute the basis function and their scores
    
    LRC_basis = matrix(eigen_decomp$vectors[,1:ncomp], ncol = ncomp)
    LRC_score = new_dat %*% LRC_basis
    
    LRC_recon = LRC_basis %*% t(LRC_score)
    LRC_resi = t(new_dat) - LRC_recon
    
    LRC_score_fore = matrix(NA, fh, ncomp)
    if(fmethod == "ets")
    {
        for(ik in 1:ncomp)
        {
            LRC_score_fore[,ik] = forecast(ets(as.numeric(LRC_score[,ik])), h = fh)$mean
        }
    }
    else if(fmethod == "arima")
    {
        for(ik in 1:ncomp)
        {
            LRC_score_fore[,ik] = forecast(auto.arima(as.numeric(LRC_score[,ik])), h = fh)$mean
        }
    }
    else
    {
        warning("Please choose a correct forecasting method.")
    }
    
    # compute long-run covariance for the residual functions
    
    LRC_resi_est = long_run_covariance_estimation(dat = LRC_resi)
    eigen_decomp_resi = eigen(LRC_resi_est, symmetric = TRUE)
    
    # determine ncomp by the ratio method
    
    lambda_val = eigen_decomp_resi$values[which(eigen_decomp_resi$values > 0)]
    ncomp_resi = select_K(tau = 1/log(max(lambda_val[1], length(lambda_val))), eigenvalue = lambda_val)
    rm(lambda_val); rm(LRC_resi_est)
    
    # compute the additional PCs and their scores
    
    LRC_resi_basis = as.matrix(eigen_decomp_resi$vectors[,1:ncomp_resi])
    LRC_resi_score = new_dat %*% LRC_resi_basis
    
    LRC_resi_score_fore = matrix(NA, fh, ncomp_resi)
    if(fmethod == "ets")
    {
        for(ik in 1:ncomp_resi)
        {
            LRC_resi_score_fore[,ik] = forecast(ets(as.numeric(LRC_resi_score[,ik])), h = fh)$mean
        }
    }
    else if(fmethod == "arima")
    {
        for(ik in 1:ncomp_resi)
        {
            LRC_resi_score_fore[,ik] = forecast(auto.arima(as.numeric(LRC_resi_score[,ik])), h = fh)$mean
        }
    }
    else
    {
        warning("Please choose a correct forecasting method.")
    }
    
    LRC_fore_curve = LRC_basis %*% matrix(LRC_score_fore, nrow = ncomp) + LRC_resi_basis %*% matrix(LRC_resi_score_fore, nrow = ncomp_resi)
    LRC_fore_curve_add_mean = LRC_fore_curve + matrix(rep(my, fh),  length(my), fh, byrow = FALSE)
    return(LRC_fore_curve_add_mean[,fh])
}

############################################################
# Selection of the optimal parameter for point forecasts
# beta_val: beta parameter
# criterion: "LRC_nonstationary"
# data: data set
# horizon: forecast horizon
# validation_year: year for validation
# err: forecast error
# forecasting_method: Forecasting_method = "ETS" or "ARIMA"
############################################################

parameter_optim <- function(beta_val, data, horizon, validation_year, err, forecasting_method)
{
    grid = nrow(data)
    n_validation_year = length(validation_year)
    validation_fore = matrix(NA, grid, (n_validation_year + 1 - horizon))
    for(iwk in 1:(n_validation_year + 1 - horizon))
    {
        validation_fore[,iwk] = GW_LRC_nonstationary(beta = beta_val, dat = data[,1:(min(validation_year) - 2 + iwk)],
                                                     fh = horizon, fmethod = forecasting_method)
    }
    if(err == "RMSPE")
    {
        err = ftsa:::rmspe(forecast = validation_fore, true = data[,(min(validation_year) + horizon - 1):max(validation_year)])
    }
    else if(err == "MAPE")
    {
        err = ftsa:::mape(forecast = validation_fore, true = data[,(min(validation_year) + horizon - 1):max(validation_year)])
    }
    else
    {
        warning("error is not correctly specified.")
    }
    return(err)
}


### RMSPE

############################################################
# Selection of the optimal parameter for interval forecasts
# beta_val: beta parameter
# data: data set
# horizon: forecast horizon
# validation_year: year for validation
# err: forecast error
# no_boot: number of bootstrap samples
# PI_level: nominal coverage probability
# forecasting_method: Forecasting_method = "ETS" or "ARIMA"
############################################################

parameter_optim_interval <- function(beta_val, data, horizon, validation_year, err, no_boot, 
                                     PI_level, forecasting_method)
{
    grid = nrow(data)
    n_validation_year = length(validation_year)
    test_fore_lb = test_fore_ub = matrix(NA, grid, (n_validation_year + 1 - horizon))
    for(iwk in 1:(n_validation_year + 1 - horizon))
    {
        dum = GW_LRC_nonstationary_boot(beta = beta_val, dat = data[,1:(min(validation_year) - 2 + iwk)], 
                                        fh = horizon, B = no_boot, level = PI_level, fmethod = forecasting_method)
        test_fore_lb[,iwk] = dum$lb[,horizon]
        test_fore_ub[,iwk] = dum$ub[,horizon]
        rm(iwk); rm(dum)
    }
    rownames(test_fore_lb) = rownames(test_fore_ub) = 0:(grid - 1)
    dum = interval_score(holdout = data[,(min(validation_year) + horizon - 1):max(validation_year)], 
                         lb = test_fore_lb, ub = test_fore_ub, alpha = (100 - PI_level)/100)
    if(err == "CPD")
    {
        return(dum[3])
    }
    else if(err == "score")
    {
        return(dum[1])
    }
    else
    {
        warning("err should be interval score or CPD.")
    }
}

# ETS

optim_mat_score_SWE_female_ETS = matrix(NA, 30, 2)
for(iwjk in 1:30)
{
    dum = optimize(f = parameter_optim_interval, lower = 0, upper = 1,

                   validation_year = SWE_validation_year, err = "score", no_boot = 1000, PI_level = 80,
                   forecasting_method = "ets")

}

#####################
# Empirical Analysis
#####################
#####################

########################################
# Tuning parameters
# training_year: 80% of the full data
# validation_year: 10% of the full data
# test_year: 10% of the full data
########################################

#################
# Testing sample
#################

# beta_selected: selected tuning parameter
# criterion: dynamic, two-stage dynamic, static FPCA
# data: p by n data matrix
# horizon: forecast horizon
# test_year: data in the testing period
# err: error criterion
# forecasting_method: univariate time-series forecasting method

point_fore_eval <- function(beta_selected, data, horizon, test_year, err, forecasting_method)
{
    grid = nrow(data)
    n_test_year = length(test_year)
    test_fore = matrix(NA, grid, (n_test_year + 1 - horizon))
    for(iwk in 1:(n_test_year + 1 - horizon))
    {
        test_fore[,iwk] = GW_LRC_nonstationary(beta = beta_selected, dat = data[,1:(min(test_year) - 2 + iwk)], fh = horizon,
                                               fmethod = forecasting_method)
        print(iwk); rm(iwk)
    }
    if(err == "RMSPE")
    {
        err = ftsa:::rmspe(forecast = test_fore, true = data[,(min(test_year) + horizon - 1):max(test_year)])
    }
    else if(err == "MAPE")
    {
        err = ftsa:::mape(forecast = test_fore, true = data[,(min(test_year) + horizon - 1):max(test_year)])
    }
    else
    {
        warning("error is not correctly specified.")
    }
    return(err)
}

     ylim = c(-4.5, 0), col = 1, lty = 1, main = "Swedish females (1751 - 2022)")
lines(ts(log(SWE_demo$rate$female, base = 10)[21,], start = min(SWE_demo$year), end = max(SWE_demo$year)),
      col = 2, lty = 2)
lines(ts(log(SWE_demo$rate$female, base = 10)[41,], start = min(SWE_demo$year), end = max(SWE_demo$year)),
      col = 3, lty = 3)
lines(ts(log(SWE_demo$rate$female, base = 10)[61,], start = min(SWE_demo$year), end = max(SWE_demo$year)),
      col = 4, lty = 4)
lines(ts(log(SWE_demo$rate$female, base = 10)[81,], start = min(SWE_demo$year), end = max(SWE_demo$year)),
      col = 5, lty = 5)
lines(ts(log(SWE_demo$rate$female, base = 10)[96,], start = min(SWE_demo$year), end = max(SWE_demo$year)),
      col = 6, lty = 6)
legend("bottomleft", c("0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "95+"), col = 1:6, lty = 1:6, ncol = 2, cex = 0.8)
dev.off()

## Plots of forecasts

savepdf("Fig_3a", width = 12, height = 10)
RMSPE_SWE_female_summary %>%
  mutate(x=1:30) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(LRC_nonstationary, LRC_nonstationary_weighted, LRC, LRC_weighted)) %>%
  mutate(color = case_when(name %in% c("LRC_nonstationary", "LRC_nonstationary_weighted") ~ "ETS",
                            name %in% c("LRC", "LRC_weighted") ~ "ARIMA"),
         lty = case_when(str_ends(name, "_weighted") ~ "Weighted", TRUE ~ "Standard")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x, y = value, color = color, lty = lty)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab('') +
  ylab('RMSPE') +
  ylim(4.5, 16.5) +
  labs(title='Female') +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.12,0.72))
dev.off()
```
